parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy (3 VP) is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Ore. Looking at my resources, I have 1 Sheep, 1 Ore, 1 Wood, and 1 Wheat. I need 1 Brick for my settlement at N51. Giving Jimmy Ore is dangerous because he is at 3 VP and likely needs it for a City or more Development Cards. I already have 1 Wheat, so getting another doesn't solve my immediate Brick shortage. I should reject the trade to prevent Jimmy from pulling ahead and to keep my Ore for my own future City or Dev card.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's Wheat-for-Ore trade. He is at 3 VP and I need to stop him from getting Ore for cities. I still need 1 Brick for N51.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, כבר אמרתי לך - אבן לא זזה ממני כרגע. זה שאתה מנסה לצבוע את זה כעזרה לי לא משנה את העובדה שאתה הכי קרוב לניצחון.
